newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Wing Sung 1996 net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Wing Sung 1996 net profit up.

text.p: Shanghai Wing Sung Co Ltd registered net profit of 2.29 million yuan in 1996 under international accounting standards, up from 1.19 million in 1995, the company said on Saturday.

Based on domestic accounting standards, the company posted net profit of 13.89 million yuan in 1996, down 36.78 percent from 21.97 million yuan in 1995, according to an annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News.
Wing Sung, primarily a stationery producer, said sharp falls in the property market and reduced income from property management fees helped cause the drop in profits under domestic standards.
Poor results of other companies in which Wing Sung has investments also hurt profits, it said.
The company gave no reasons for the rise in profit under international standards, but noted a reduction in provisions for losses by related enterprises.
The company's board of directors have proposed a 1.5-for-10 bonus issue pending approval at a shareholders' meeting on May 31.
